name: 文本差异对比
Text Diff
description: 对比两段文本的差异：文本模式按行标注增删，JSON 模式按结构化路径标注。

mode: 文本模式按行做最长公共子序列对比；JSON 模式按结构化路径（如 $.items[0].name）标注增删改。
Text mode diffs line by line with LCS; JSON mode annotates changes by structured path such as $.items[0].name.
output: 结果给出新增、删除与未变的行数；JSON 模式下按路径列出每处差异。
The result reports added, removed and unchanged counts; in JSON mode every change is listed by path.

Why is an empty side an error?
a: 差异对比需要两个基准，空输入无法判定差异，因此按缺少字段处理。
A diff needs both sides; an empty input cannot be compared and is reported as a missing field.

q: JSON 模式如何处理数组长度变化？
How are array length changes handled in JSON mode?
a: 按下标逐项比较，多出的元素标记为新增，少掉的标记为删除。
Items are compared by index: extra elements are marked as inserted and missing ones as deleted.

a: 统一使用 RE2 方言（Go 正则），不支持回溯引用与递归等特性。
The RE2 flavour (Go regular expressions) is used throughout; backreferences and recursion are not supported.

q: 和正则测试工具有什么区别？
How does this differ from the regex tester?
a: 正则测试会实际匹配文本并给出全部命中；本工具只判断表达式本身是否合法。
The regex tester actually matches text and lists every hit; this tool only judges whether the expression itself is valid.

Does this replace a password manager?
a: 不能。它只做规则判断，不评估口令是否已被泄露。
No. It only applies rules and does not check whether a password has been breached.

q: 常见弱口令列表有多全？
How complete is the weak password list?
a: 只收录最常见的一批，完整判断需要接入泄露库，那超出本工具范围。
Only the most common ones are included; a full check needs a breach database, which is out of scope here.

name: 动态口令生成校验
TOTP Generator
description: 生成与校验 TOTP 动态口令，支持 SHA1、SHA256 与 SHA512。
Generate and verify TOTP codes with SHA1, SHA256 and SHA512.

secret: 密钥是 Base32 文本；空格与连字符会自动忽略。
The secret is Base32 text; spaces and hyphens are ignored.
output: HMAC 计算经 cryptosvc 转调 Tongsuo，本工具不自行实现 HMAC。
HMAC computation goes through cryptosvc to Tongsuo; this tool does not implement HMAC itself.

q: Is it compatible with common authenticator apps?
a: 兼容。标准参数下结果与主流验证器一致。
Yes. With standard parameters the result matches mainstream authenticators.
SHA1 是兼容面最广的默认算法；安全性更高的场景请选 SHA256 或 SHA512。
SHA1 has the widest compatibility; choose SHA256 or SHA512 where stronger security matters.

name: 证书生命周期
Certificate Lifecycle
description: 计算证书的有效期区间、到期倒计时与续期建议。
Compute a certificate's validity window, expiry countdown and renewal advice.

certificate: 粘贴 PEM 文本即可；证书解析走 pkisvc，与仓库其他证书工具口径一致。
Paste the PEM text; parsing goes through pkisvc for consistency with the other certificate tools.
output: 状态分为有效、即将过期、已过期与尚未生效四种。
The status is one of valid, expiring, expired or not yet valid.

q: Does it check the certificate chain?
a: 不能，只看单张证书。链验证请用证书链验证工具。
No, it looks at a single certificate. Use the chain verifier for chains.

q: 自签名证书需要注意什么？
a: 自签名证书需要客户端单独信任该 CA，不适合公开环境。
Clients must trust that CA explicitly, so they are unsuitable for public environments.

name: SSH 密钥生成
SSH Key Generator
description: 生成 OpenSSH 格式的密钥对，输出私钥、authorized_keys 公钥行与 SHA256 指纹。
Generate an OpenSSH key pair with the private key, an authorized_keys line and a SHA256 fingerprint.

algorithm: 首版**只支持未加密私钥**：口令加密变体需要 bcrypt KDF，属上游能力缺口，暂不提供。
The first version supports unencrypted private keys only: the passphrase-encrypted variant needs a bcrypt KDF that the upstream library does not yet provide.
output: 私钥请妥善保管；指纹可用于核对两端是否一致。
Keep the private key safe; the fingerprint lets you confirm both ends match.

q: 能生成带口令的私钥吗？
Can it generate a passphrase-protected key?
a: 暂不能。口令加密需要 bcrypt KDF 与密文格式转换，按规范须走上游支持，不做自研兜底。
Not yet. It needs a bcrypt KDF and encrypted-key format conversion, which must come from the upstream library rather than a home-grown fallback.

q: What format is the private key in?
a: OpenSSH 的 openssh-key-v1 格式，可直接写入 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519。
The openssh-key-v1 format, which can be written straight to ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.
